title: Provision ECS Task Definition
scenario: Your platform team needs ECS Task Definition for a small Fargate task blueprint. Write a reusable Terraform configuration that provisions it, drives every input through variables, applies the standard tags, and exports the operational identifiers.
constraints: Create exactly one resource of type aws_ecs_task_definition.
All configurable values must come from variables declared in variables.tf.
Code must pass terraform fmt conventions (2-space indents, trailing newline, no tabs).
